About Greenfield

Greenfield International School was established in 1998 in Pune. We offer education from Nursery to Grade 12.

Our campus has 1,800 students as of 2025 and an average class size of 24.

Our student teacher ratio is 12:1. Greenfield is part of the Greenfield Education Trust.

More than 9000 students attended our online webinars in 2021.

Our Principal and the Academic Director lead the academic team.
